title: Nature awards recognize inspiring women in science
title_zh: 自然奖表彰鼓舞人心的科学女性
abstract: This year’s winners are a materials scientist and a champion of women’s science education. They — like all those shortlisted — are driven by the desire to support others.
abstract_zh: 今年的获奖者是一位材料科学家和一位女性科学教育倡导者。她们——如同所有入围者一样——都出于支持他人的愿望而行动。
